messages:
maria_sales: Heads up: new enterprise POC (Zephyr) starts next Wed. Customer expects 250qps peaks, 90s sessions, mixed chat+embed workload. Need quick presales: reserved GPU rec, autoscale knob, preheat runbook, and pricing delta.

sam_se: Is traffic bursty or sustained? model?

maria_sales: Burst-heavy. baseline 80qps, spikes ~250 for 5-20m every 40-60m. They picked rwd-70b-qat. 99th target ~700ms.

alex_dev: For rwd-70b-qat: recommend reserved 3x A100 for baseline, autoscale to 6 for spikes. Continuous batching + KV cache needed. Preheat 90-120m before go-live; warm top 15 prompts.

alex_dev: Autoscale example: min=3, max=6, policy=queue+token_rate, scale_up_threshold=0.7, cooldown=20s. Use prewarmed nodes to avoid cold-starts.

jordan_fin: Pricing sketch: 3 reserved A100 ~ $13k/mo; burst credits for avg spike profile ~ $4-5k/mo. On-demand only would be ~2x. I'll make a formal quote.

ops_oncall: Add AZ spread and audit log note for security questionnaire. Also add fallback policy to rwd-30b with graceful tiering.

maria_sales: Great. Can someone make the runbook and open a capacity ticket? Need text for security questionnaire about isolation.

alex_dev: I'll draft runbook and attach preheat script + commands. Assigning ticket to infra-bot to create INF-2180.

infra-bot: Ticket INF-2180 created: "Zephyr POC capacity prep" assigned to alex_dev, due_in:48h.
